subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(**NOTE:** Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits.)

(2, 4, 18)

(1, 9, 50)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 **First number + Second number = (New\: number)²over2 = Third number.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60c7c4a27054eb0178b47c32955d1d68c3ee80bdc1c7d43832ae8444d91e527b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a261ae295721f4e4242e76bdb3ea153ead240ce80d746f92a4388e8b3fe6751.png] 

Now, let us check each option:

**Option 1: (3, 5, 32) **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f62a986960d2bb31beb4a393ab8f4114b09ad36a0a4ea1e470eb7f85953c33f.png] **

The logic apply here, so it will be the answer.

Option 2: (2, 5, 49) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eec5c9c3138750a819ae846789c109234eed9fe89a844593abc2cc4149f1e8c.png] 

Option 3: (6, 4, 10) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae6c1938311148a07432e767d8348d8f5123dd622362085e91f3f5b471376116.png] 

Option 4: (5, 4, 18) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31c86543fb7c10cf0bf5277a14d91e6122f8c5a51c57ab0c1bea7bd88240977e.png] 

 Hence, **'Option 1'** is the correct answer.
